reuse.why: Uses the existing link.ensureAccountNotLinked and link.findOrCreateBank helpers and the shared post/BankSyncError/handleSyncResponse, but there is no shared link-account or download helper, so the rest is re-copied rather than factored.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade/insert/payee/sync/notify) and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, adding two more copies of logic already duplicated per provider.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts dispatch, server URL in server-config.ts and the account type under types/models, exactly where the other providers live.

scope.why: Only the provider wiring the request needs; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing per-provider pattern and easy to follow, but every future change to linking/downloading must now be made in one more copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through link.ensureAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and bankSync.syncAccount as the other providers do.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (linkFintegraAccount vs linkAkahuAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions vs downloadAkahuTransactions) are plain, recognisable copies, not reshaped.
